document_title: Revisions to Rules and Regulations Tariff Compliance Filing - CLEAN version of the revised tariff sheets
how_obtained: Fetched the GA PSC FACTS document-detail page /search/facts-document/?documentId=221656 to read its download link, then downloaded the ZIP 'dkt_44280_revisions_to_rules_and_regs_tariff_compliance_filing.zip' from the public API endpoint https://services.psc.ga.gov/api/v1/External/Public/Get/Document/DownloadFile/221656/102762. Unzipped it and took only 'Clean/DKT 44280 Clean.pdf'. Its redlined twin 'Tracked/DKT 44280 Tracked.pdf' from the same archive is saved separately as ga-44280-rules-regs-tariff-compliance-tracked.txt - the two are the same tariff sheets in clean and tracked-changes form. Converted the PDF to text with pdfminer.six extract_text(). Saved exactly as pdfminer emitted it - no reflow, no de-hyphenation, no ligature or soft-hyphen repair; running heads, marginal line-number columns, dot leaders and form feeds all left in place.
